questions.prompt: Which of these are dog breeds?
questions.fact: Ragdoll, Bengal and Sphynx are all cat breeds. A Sphynx has almost no fur.

questions.prompt: Which of these are root vegetables?
questions.fact: Carrots were mostly purple or yellow until orange ones were bred in the Netherlands in the 1600s.

questions.prompt: At what temperature does water boil, in degrees Fahrenheit?
questions.fact: 212 °F at sea level. Water freezes at 32 °F, so the two are 180 degrees apart.

questions.prompt: How many minutes long is an NBA basketball game, not counting stoppages?
questions.fact: Four quarters of 12 minutes, though with the clock stopping it usually takes more than two hours.

questions.prompt: Which mountains are usually taken as the border of Europe and Asia?
questions.hint: They run north to south through Russia.
questions.fact: The Urals stretch about 2,500 km from the Arctic Ocean to Kazakhstan.

questions.hint: The same author wrote Animal Farm.
questions.fact: George Orwell was a pen name. His real name was Eric Blair.
